result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but there are a few layout issues: truncated cards at the right edge of the 'Fastest near you' row and the category filter chips, inconsistent card sizing, and a partially cut-off promo card at the bottom of the viewport.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccola' card in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with its name and image partially clipped.
issues.suggestion: If this is a horizontally scrollable carousel, add a visual affordance (e.g., partial peek with fade or scroll indicator); otherwise adjust card widths so full cards fit within the viewport.

issues.description: The last category filter chip is clipped at the right edge of the screen, suggesting a scrollable chip row with no visible indication of more options.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade-out gradient or partial chip visibility cue so users understand the filter list scrolls horizontally.

issues.description: Card sizes in the 'Fastest near you' row are inconsistent: 'Smash Bros Burgers' card is narrower and its image/text block alignment differs from the neighboring cards, making the row look uneven.
issues.suggestion: Use uniform card widths and consistent image aspect ratios across the row.

issues.description: The bottom card (with the −20% badge) is cut off mid-content at the viewport bottom, showing only the top of the pizza image with no title visible.
issues.suggestion: If this is expected scroll behavior it's fine, but ensure the card's badge and image render completely when scrolled; avoid cropping that hides the badge context.
